model.description: Tower Three presents Deadhead OG, a premium 3.5g flower offering that delivers a potent, memorable experience. This legendary strain is renowned for its powerful effects that combine deep relaxation with euphoric uplift, making it a favorite among discerning cannabis enthusiasts. Deadhead OG's distinctive aroma profile features earthy, pine, and diesel notes with a pungent undertone that speaks to its quality and potency. The dense, resinous buds showcase careful cultivation and curing, ensuring optimal freshness and cannabinoid preservation. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or seeking relief, this classic strain provides a well-rounded experience that honors its celebrated lineage. Perfect for evening use, Deadhead OG from Tower Three brings craft-quality flower to your collection in a convenient eighth-ounce format.
